component.name: Astrelle
component.summary: A calm, fast browser that's light on your data

description.p: Astrelle is a web browser built on Firefox ESR, with Firefox's security updates and add-ons, and a calmer, glassier way to browse.

ul.li: Tabs down the side, with workspaces for separate sets of tabs, or classic tabs on top
Compact mode: the bars hide until your mouse reaches the edge
Split view, and Peek: Shift+click a link to look at it without leaving the page
Frosted glass over a wallpaper, in colour themes that follow light and dark
Media controls in the sidebar for whatever plays in another tab
Sip, a built-in data saver for capped internet: how much you use, warnings before you run out, and no videos playing by themselves
Ad and tracker blocking with uBlock Origin, one click away

description.p: Astrelle is not made by Mozilla.
